summary: The clocked host calls the count-taking persistent OpenMP worker. It calculates thread row ownership, then for each requested iteration visits every assigned row and its full CSR interval, performs value*vec[column] accumulation and writes the row output. The count controls the compiled inner repetition loop.

source_evidence.claim: Persistent iteration loop wraps full row/nonzero work; nItems and iteration count are parsed/computed and passed to the timed routine.

compiled_evidence.claim: Clocked GOMP launch targets the iterations worker. Worker body calculates row work, loops requested passes, accumulates full CSR nonzeros and stores output; wrapper handles team completion.
